tasks.title: Collectors + 10s cache + GET /system/status + /system/hardware
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/010-system-status-introspection/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/status.feature}. SECOND: implement api/internal/managers/system_collectors.go (REQ-1000/1001) sampling /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, df, vcgencmd, HAL probes every 5s into in-memory cache (10s TTL). Implement handlers/system_status.go + handlers/system_hardware.go (REQ-1011/1012) with WebSocket push on hardware change. Full Swagger annotations per Article XII.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd api && go test -v -run TestSystemStatus ./internal/handlers/ && go test -v -run TestSystemCollectors ./internal/managers/
